name: Grand Hyatt Rio de Janeiro
positioning: Resort hotel in Barra da Tijuca, Rio de Janeiro, overlooking a nature reserve with easy beach access, rooms designed by Yabu Pushelberg and the Atiaia Spa
best_for: Travelers who want a resort stay with beach access, a spa and a pool in Rio's Barra da Tijuca
Families who want a kids club and daily resort activities

facts.text: The resort hotel overlooks a nature reserve and has easy beach access.
The hotel is near Barra da Tijuca, an area known for its beach, shopping and urban attractions.
Rooms look out to the Atlantic Ocean and to sunsets over the lagoon.
Atiaia Spa has nine treatment suites, three of them for couples.
Atiaia means luminosity in Tupi-Guarani, one of Brazil's native languages.
The hotel has an outdoor pool with views of the surrounding area.
Grand Club guests get a breakfast buffet and an afternoon cocktail hour with appetizers.
Resort amenities include beach service with sunbeds, parasols and towels.
The Kids Club has a ball pit, a trampoline, table football, a slide, video games and a baby area.
The fitness center is open 24 hours and has a multifunctional studio with training sessions and yoga classes.
Shiso is the hotel's Japanese restaurant, with an open kitchen, a sake bar and the Omakase Zen tasting menu.
Canto Gastro & Lounge was designed by Arthur Casas and has a large mural inspired by Roberto Burle Marx.

highlights.text: The rooms were designed by the international design studio Yabu Pushelberg, using native stones and exclusive fabrics.
Every room and suite has a large private balcony.
Suites offer dining and living areas with landscaped terraces, and some have an infinity pool.
The Grand Club Lounge has panoramic views of Praia da Barra and Lagoa de Marapendi.

considerations.text: The nearest Metro station in Barra da Tijuca is a 15-minute drive from the hotel.
A daily resort fee applies to each room.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
